data.enName: Thermal Expansion Properties of Fe-Ni-Co Super-Invar Alloy with Mn
data.zhName: Mn元素对Fe-Ni-Co合金热膨胀性能影响
data.enAbstract: Investigation was made on the effect of Mn on both phase and thermal expansion properties of(Fe64Ni32Co4)1-xMnx(x=0,2.2,4.4,6.6(%,mass fraction)) alloy.The hyperfine magnetic field distribution(HMFD) of alloys was measured by Mossbauer spectra to study the influenced mechanism of Mn on the thermal expansion property.The results revealed that Mn added alloy has single FCC phase,and the thermal expansion coefficient of alloys increased with increasing the Mn content.The mossbauer spectra of the alloys with low content Mn(x≤4.4%) were composed of ferromagnetic pattern,but it was composed of ferromagnetic and paramagnetic patterns when the Mn content was increased to 6.6%.The main reason for the increase of thermal expansion coefficient of(Fe64Ni32Co4)1-xMnx alloys is that the volume contraction effect in the process of high spin Fe atoms transfer to low spin Fe atoms with increasing temperature is weaken by the decrease of high spin Fe atoms with increasing the Mn content.
data.zhAbstract: 研究了Mn对(Fe64Ni32Co4)1-xMnx(x=0,2.2,4.4,6.6(%,质量分数))合金物相、热膨胀性能影响,利用穆斯堡尔谱分析了合金内场分布及Mn对合金热膨胀性能的影响机制。结果表明,Mn促使合金生成FCC单相,增大其热膨胀系数。Mn含量较低时,穆斯堡尔谱为连续的铁磁六线谱迭加而成,当Mn含量增加到6.6%后则由顺磁单峰和铁磁六线谱迭加组成,Mn元素添加降低了合金中高自旋Fe原子数量,进而减弱升温过程中高自旋Fe原子向低自旋原子引起的体积缩小作用,是导致合金热膨胀系数增加的主要原因。

data.pieces: Thermal Expansion Properties of Fe-Ni-Co Super-Invar Alloy with Mn. Investigation was made on the effect of Mn on both phase and thermal expansion properties of(Fe64Ni32Co4)1-xMnx(x=0,2.2,4.4,6.6(%,mass fraction)) alloy.The hyperfine magnetic field distribution(HMFD) of alloys was measured by Mossbauer spectra to study the influenced mechanism of Mn on the thermal expansion property.The results revealed that Mn added alloy has single FCC phase,and the thermal expansion coefficient of alloys increased with increasing the Mn content.The mossbauer spectra of the alloys with low content Mn(x≤4.4%) were composed of ferromagnetic pattern,but it was composed of ferromagnetic and paramagnetic patterns when the Mn content was increased to 6.6%.The main reason for the increase of thermal expansion coefficient of(Fe64Ni32Co4)1-xMnx alloys is that the volume contraction effect in the process of high spin Fe atoms transfer to low spin Fe atoms with increasing temperature is weaken by the decrease of high spin Fe atoms with increasing the Mn content.

data.enName: Microstructure characterisation and CTE study of Fe—42Ni—Nb invar alloys
data.zhName: Fe-42Ni-Nb因瓦合金的微观结构表征与热膨胀系数（CTE）研究
data.enAbstract: Invar alloy has low coefficient of thermal expansion; however, the week strength always limits its application. To circumvent this problem, the authors have designed Fe—42%Ni—Nb invar alloy using midfrequency vacuum induction melting technique. The microstructures of this alloy were characterised by means of XRD, SEM and TEM. The multicomponent composition (NiFeCMnNb) is chosen such that upon chill casting of the alloy the liquid undergoes a metastable reaction, forming a strengthening NbC precipitated phase on γ-(Fe, Ni) solid solution. As a result, the alloy achieves the low coefficient of thermal expansion α30–100=6·14 × 10−6 K−1 ranged from room temperature to 100°C. The results show: in NiFe invar alloys, the primary phases are γ-(NiFe), FeNi3) Ni and Fe2C; and with the addition of carbon, manganese and rare earth niobium, NiFeCMnNb invar alloy achieves such primary phases as γ-(NiFe) and NbyCx; and TEM structure consists of superfine structure and its matrix is γ-(NiFe).
data.zhAbstract: 因瓦合金具有低的热膨胀系数；然而，其强度较低一直限制着它的应用。为解决这一问题，作者采用中频真空感应熔炼技术设计了Fe-42%Ni-Nb因瓦合金。通过X射线衍射（XRD）、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和透射电子显微镜（TEM）对该合金的微观结构进行了表征。选择多组分成分（NiFeCMnNb），使得合金在激冷铸造时，液相发生亚稳反应，在γ-(Fe, Ni)固溶体上形成强化的NbC析出相。结果，该合金在室温至100°C范围内实现了6·14×10−6 K−1的低热膨胀系数α30–100。结果表明：在NiFe因瓦合金中，初生相为γ-(NiFe)、FeNi3、Ni和Fe2C；添加碳、锰和稀土铌后，NiFeCMnNb因瓦合金获得了γ-(NiFe)和NbyCx等初生相；TEM结构由超细结构组成，其基体为γ-(NiFe)。

data.enName: Unlocking the potential of non-ferromagnetic Invar-type alloys in space exploration
data.zhName: 释放非铁磁性因瓦型合金在太空探索中的潜力
data.enAbstract: The effects of Fe and Mn on the thermal expansion characteristics of non-ferromagnetic Cr-Fe-Mn alloys, which exhibit the Invar effect, were investigated. It was found that the temperature range in which the alloy exhibits low thermal expansion characteristics is below 273 K when the Mn content is less than 0.3%. Conversely, this range shifts to between 273 and 350 K when the Mn content increases to 0.9% or higher. By incorporating small amounts of rare earth elements, the Cr94.6Fe4.7Mn0.7 alloy achieved an average coefficient of thermal expansion of 0.94 × 10−6/K between 273 and 350 K, which is lower than the 1.2 × 10−6/K observed in conventional Invar alloys. Additionally, measurements of magnetic hysteresis loops were conducted to assess the residual magnetization, which is critical for structural components near magnetic measurement equipment. The results indicated that the residual magnetization of the Cr-based Invar-type alloy is approximately 0.0033 mT, significantly lower than the 35 mT typically found in conventional Invar. These substantial differences underscore the potential of Cr-based Invar-type alloys as a superior alternative for applications requiring low thermal expansion and low residual magnetization.
data.zhAbstract: 研究了铁（Fe）和锰（Mn）对呈现因瓦效应的非铁磁性Cr-Fe-Mn合金热膨胀特性的影响。研究发现，当锰含量小于0.3%时，合金呈现低热膨胀特性的温度范围低于273K。相反，当锰含量增加到0.9%或更高时，该温度范围会移至273至350K之间。通过加入少量稀土元素，Cr94.6Fe4.7Mn0.7合金在273至350K之间实现了0.94×10−6/K的平均热膨胀系数，低于传统因瓦合金中观察到的1.2×10−6/K。此外，还进行了磁滞回线测量以评估剩余磁化强度，这对于靠近磁测量设备的结构部件至关重要。结果表明，Cr基因瓦型合金的剩余磁化强度约为0.0033mT，显著低于传统因瓦合金中通常发现的35mT。这些显著差异突出了Cr基因瓦型合金作为需要低热膨胀和低剩余磁化强度应用的优质替代品的潜力。

data.pieces: Unlocking the potential of non-ferromagnetic Invar-type alloys in space exploration. The effects of Fe and Mn on the thermal expansion characteristics of non-ferromagnetic Cr-Fe-Mn alloys, which exhibit the Invar effect, were investigated. It was found that the temperature range in which the alloy exhibits low thermal expansion characteristics is below 273 K when the Mn content is less than 0.3%. Conversely, this range shifts to between 273 and 350 K when the Mn content increases to 0.9% or higher. By incorporating small amounts of rare earth elements, the Cr94.6Fe4.7Mn0.7 alloy achieved an average coefficient of thermal expansion of 0.94 × 10−6/K between 273 and 350 K, which is lower than the 1.2 × 10−6/K observed in conventional Invar alloys. data.enName: Exceptional dimensional stability of non-ferromagnetic Invar alloy for advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment
data.zhName: 用于先进半导体制造设备的非铁磁性因瓦合金的卓越尺寸稳定性
data.enAbstract: To elucidate the thermal and magnetic dimensional stability of Cr-based Invar, the effects of various alloying elements on thermal expansion and magnetic properties were investigated. The Cr-Fe-Mn alloys exhibit low thermal expansion characteristics near room temperature, with the addition of Mn significantly elevating the Néel temperature. Specifically, the addition of approximately 0.89% Mn adjusted the low thermal expansion region to be close to room temperature, while 1.4% Sn raised it to temperatures below 0°C. The average thermal expansion coefficient (CTE) of Cr-based Invar at a temperature range between 20 and 30°C was found to be 1.7ppm/°C, comparable to the 0.90ppm/°C of conventional Invar, and approached nearly zero around 50 to 60°C. Magnetic measurements indicated that Cr-based Invar exhibits negligible magnetization compared to conventional Invars, with magnetization less than one-thousandth of Invar 36. This low magnetization results in minimal magnetostriction, making Cr-based Invar suitable for applications requiring both thermal and magnetic stability. Under a magnetic field strength of 796kA/m, Cr-based Invar showed a slight contraction behavior, unlike other Invars which expanded. This contraction is attributed to the antiferromagnetic nature of Cr, where magnetic moments align in opposite directions, leading to a net magnetization of zero.
data.zhAbstract: 为了阐明铬基因瓦合金的热稳定性和磁尺寸稳定性，研究了各种合金元素对热膨胀和磁性能的影响。Cr-Fe-Mn合金在室温附近表现出低热膨胀特性，添加锰会显著提高奈尔温度。具体而言，添加约0.89%的锰可将低热膨胀区域调整至接近室温，而添加1.4%的锡可将其提高至低于0°C的温度。发现铬基因瓦合金在20至30°C温度范围内的平均热膨胀系数（CTE）为1.7ppm/°C，与传统因瓦合金的0.90ppm/°C相当，并且在50至60°C左右接近零。磁性测量表明，与传统因瓦合金相比，铬基因瓦合金的磁化强度可忽略不计，其磁化强度不到因瓦36的千分之一。这种低磁化强度导致磁致伸缩最小，使得铬基因瓦合金适用于需要热稳定性和磁稳定性的应用。在796kA/m的磁场强度下，铬基因瓦合金表现出轻微的收缩行为，这与其他因瓦合金膨胀的情况不同。这种收缩归因于铬的反铁磁性质，其中磁矩沿相反方向排列，导致净磁化强度为零。

To elucidate the thermal and magnetic dimensional stability of Cr-based Invar, the effects of various alloying elements on thermal expansion and magnetic properties were investigated. The Cr-Fe-Mn alloys exhibit low thermal expansion characteristics near room temperature, with the addition of Mn significantly elevating the Néel temperature. Specifically, the addition of approximately 0.89% Mn adjusted the low thermal expansion region to be close to room temperature, while 1.4% Sn raised it to temperatures below 0°C. {"thought":"Let me analyze the literature findings and the model files:

**Literature Findings Summary:**

1. **Invar mechanism**: The Invar effect in Fe65Ni35 originates from the cancellation of magnetic and phonon contributions to entropy. Fe-Fe pairs dominantly contribute to volume expansion via the magnetovolume effect. The Invar effect is a delicate balance between Fe-Fe pair number and their elongation depending on magnetization.

2. **Al/Ti TEC increase mechanism**: 
   - Al and Ti are early 3d/sp elements that when added to Fe-Ni Invar, dilute the Fe-Fe magnetic pairs
   - They reduce the number of high-spin Fe atoms, weakening the magnetovolume compensation
   - Similar to Mn: "Mn元素添加降低了合金中高自旋Fe原子数量,进而减弱升温过程中高自旋Fe原子向低自旋原子引起的体积缩小作用" - Mn reduces high-spin Fe atoms, weakening the volume contraction during heating
   - Al has strong tendency to form ordered phases (FeNi3-Al), disrupting the disordered FCC solid solution needed for Invar effect
   - Ti forms intermetallic compounds that can precipitate out, changing the matrix composition

3. **Alternative light elements**:
   - **Si**: Wang et al. (2024) showed Si can substitute Nb in Fe-based BMGs without increasing α while raising Tc. Si is light (28.09 g/mol) and can stabilize FCC phase
   - **B**: Used in Fe-based BMGs with Invar effect, very light (10.81 g/mol)
   - **Cr**: Onoue et al. (2015) showed Cr decreases magnetization (early 3d), but Cr-based Invar alloys show excellent low CTE. Cr is not very light though (52 g/mol)
   - **Co**: Increases magnetization, used in Super-Invar (Fe-Ni-Co), but not light (58.9 g/mol)
   - **Mn**: Increases magnetization but also increases CTE at higher contents
   - **Zr**: Wang et al. (2023) showed 0.22 wt% Zr in Fe-36Ni achieved CTE of 0.66×10⁻⁶/°C - but Zr is heavy

For low-density Invar, the key light elements to consider:
- **Si** (28.09, ρ=2.33): Stabilizes FCC, moderate effect on magnetism, can maintain low CTE
- **B** (10.81, ρ=2.34): Very light, but limited solubility in FCC
- **C** (12.01, ρ=2.27): Very light, but limited solubility; carbon in γ-phase affects CTE
- **Mn** (54.94, ρ=7.21): Not light, but lighter than Ni (58.69) and can partially substitute

Now let me examine the model files. They are PyTorch .pt files (tec_0.pt through tec_4.pt) - likely an ensemble of 5 models predicting TEC.

I need to:
1. Inspect the model structure to understand input features
2. Build a genetic algorithm for multi-objective optimization (minimize TEC, minimize density)
3. Generate Pareto-optimal candidates

Let me first inspect the model files to understand their structure.
"}

{"command":"create","file_text":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Multi-objective Pareto optimization for Fe-Ni based low-density Invar alloy.
Objectives: minimize TEC, minimize density.
Uses DPA-2 property model ensemble (tec_0..4.pt) as surrogate.
"""

import numpy as np
import torch
import os
import json
import itertools
from pathlib import Path

# ============================================================
# 1. COMPOSITION CONSTRAINTS (from literature diagnosis)
# ============================================================
# Elements: Fe (balance), Ni, Al, Ti, Si, Mn, Co, Cr
# Based on literature:
# - Al: max 3 at% (strong TEC increase via diluting Fe-Fe magnetic pairs)
# - Ti: max 2 at% (forms precipitates, disrupts magnetovolume)
# - Si: 0-8 at% (light, can maintain low CTE per Wang2024)
# - Mn: 0-5 at% (reduces high-spin Fe, moderate TEC increase)
# - Co: 0-6 at% (enhances magnetization, Super-Invar component)
# - Cr: 0-4 at% (decreases magnetization but antiferro Invar possible)
# - Ni: 28-38 at% (Invar window)
# - Fe: balance (50-70 at%)

ELEMENTS = ['Fe', 'Ni', 'Al', 'Ti', 'Si', 'Mn', 'Co', 'Cr']
ATOMIC_MASS = {'Fe': 55.845, 'Ni': 58.693, 'Al': 26.982, 'Ti': 47.867,
               'Si': 28.086, 'Mn': 54.938, 'Co': 58.933, 'Cr': 51.996}
# Approximate atomic volumes in FCC solid solution (Angstrom^3)
ATOMIC_VOL = {'Fe': 11.78, 'Ni': 10.94, 'Al': 16.60, 'Ti': 17.65,
              'Si': 12.06, 'Mn': 12.21, 'Co': 11.12, 'Cr': 12.28}

# Bounds: [min, max] in atomic fraction
BOUNDS = {
    'Ni': (0.28, 0.38),
    'Al': (0.00, 0.03),
    'Ti': (0.00, 0.02),
    'Si': (0.00, 0.08),
    'Mn': (0.00, 0.05),
    'Co': (0.00, 0.06),
    'Cr': (0.00, 0.04),
}
# Fe is balance: Fe = 1 - sum(others)
FE_MIN = 0.50
FE_MAX = 0.70


def calc_density(comp_dict):
    """Calculate density (g/cm3) from composition using Vegard's law for volume."""
    avg_mass = sum(comp_dict[e] * ATOMIC_MASS[e] for e in ELEMENTS)
    avg_vol = sum(comp_dict[e] * ATOMIC_VOL[e] for e in ELEMENTS)
    # density = mass / volume, convert: g/mol / (cm3/mol)
    # avg_vol in A^3/atom, convert to cm3/mol: avg_vol * 1e-24 * 6.022e23
    vol_cm3_per_mol = avg_vol * 1e-24 * 6.022e23
    density = avg_mass / vol_cm3_per_mol
    return density


def build_fcc_supercell(comp_dict, n_atoms=32):
    """Build a 2x2x2 FCC supercell (32 atoms) with random site occupation."""
    # FCC lattice parameter from Vegard's law
    avg_vol = sum(comp_dict[e] * ATOMIC_VOL[e] for e in ELEMENTS)
    a_lat = (4 * avg_vol) ** (1.0/3.0)  # 4 atoms per FCC unit cell
    
    # 2x2x2 supercell = 32 atoms
    cell = np.diag([2*a_lat, 2*a_lat, 2*a_lat])
    
    # FCC basis positions in fractional coords
    basis = np.array([[0,0,0],[0.5,0.5,0],[0.5,0,0.5],[0,0.5,0.5]])
    positions = []
    for ix, iy, iz in itertools.product(range(2), repeat=3):
        for b in basis:
            frac = (np.array([ix, iy, iz]) + b) / 2.0
            positions.append(frac @ cell)
    positions = np.array(positions)
    
    # Assign atom types based on composition
    # Type indices follow periodic table: H=0, He=1, ..., Fe=25, Co=26, Ni=27, etc.
    type_map_idx = {'H':0,'He':1,'Li':2,'Be':3,'B':4,'C':5,'N':6,'O':7,'F':8,'Ne':9,
                    'Na':10,'Mg':11,'Al':12,'Si':13,'P':14,'S':15,'Cl':16,'Ar':17,
                    'K':18,'Ca':19,'Sc':20,'Ti':21,'V':22,'Cr':23,'Mn':24,'Fe':25,'Co':26,'Ni':27,'Cu':28}
    
    # Determine number of atoms for each element
    n_atoms_elem = {}
    remaining = n_atoms
    for elem in ELEMENTS[1:]:  # Skip Fe (balance)
        n_elem = int(round(comp_dict[elem] * n_atoms))
        n_elem = min(n_elem, remaining)
        n_atoms_elem[elem] = n_elem
        remaining -= n_elem
    n_atoms_elem['Fe'] = remaining
    
    # Create type array
    types = []
    for elem in ELEMENTS:
        types.extend([type_map_idx[elem]] * n_atoms_elem.get(elem, 0))
    
    # Shuffle to randomize
    np.random.shuffle(types)
    types = np.array(types)
    
    return positions, types, cell


def predict_tec_ensemble(models, positions, types, cell):
    """Predict TEC using model ensemble. Returns mean and std."""
    # Prepare input data dict for deepmd-kit model

    echo "Waiting... ${i}x15s"

"""
NSGA-II Pareto optimization for Fe-Ni low-density Invar alloy.
Objectives: minimize TEC (ppm/K), minimize density (g/cm³).
Surrogate: 5-model DPA-2 ensemble (tec_0..4.pt).
"""
import os, warnings, sys
os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS'] = '4'
os.environ['DP_INTRA_OP_PARALLELISM_THREADS'] = '4'
os.environ['DP_INTER_OP_PARALLELISM_THREADS'] = '2'
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

import numpy as np
import itertools
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

# ============================================================
# COMPOSITION SPACE
# ============================================================
ELEMENTS = ['Fe', 'Ni', 'Al', 'Ti', 'Si', 'Mn', 'Co', 'Cr']
ATOMIC_MASS = {'Fe':55.845,'Ni':58.693,'Al':26.982,'Ti':47.867,
               'Si':28.086,'Mn':54.938,'Co':58.933,'Cr':51.996}
# Goldschmidt radii → FCC atomic volumes (Å³)
ATOMIC_VOL  = {'Fe':11.78,'Ni':10.94,'Al':16.60,'Ti':17.65,
               'Si':12.06,'Mn':12.21,'Co':11.12,'Cr':12.28}
# Type indices in DPA-2 universal type map
TYPE_IDX = {'Fe':25,'Ni':27,'Al':12,'Ti':21,'Si':13,'Mn':24,'Co':26,'Cr':23}

# Composition bounds (at. frac.)
BOUNDS = {
    'Ni': (0.28, 0.38),
    'Al': (0.00, 0.03),
    'Ti': (0.00, 0.02),
    'Si': (0.00, 0.08),
    'Mn': (0.00, 0.05),
    'Co': (0.00, 0.06),
    'Cr': (0.00, 0.04),
}
FE_MIN, FE_MAX = 0.50, 0.70

N_ATOMS = 32  # 2×2×2 FCC supercell

# ============================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================
def calc_density(comp):
    avg_m = sum(comp[e]*ATOMIC_MASS[e] for e in ELEMENTS)
    avg_v = sum(comp[e]*ATOMIC_VOL[e]  for e in ELEMENTS)
    return avg_m / (avg_v * 1e-24 * 6.022e23)   # g/cm³

def build_supercell(comp, seed=None):
    """Build 2×2×2 FCC supercell with SQS-like random occupation."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    avg_v = sum(comp[e]*ATOMIC_VOL[e] for e in ELEMENTS)
    a = (4*avg_v)**(1/3)
    cell = np.diag([2*a]*3)
    basis = np.array([[0,0,0],[.5,.5,0],[.5,0,.5],[0,.5,.5]])
    pos = []
    for ix,iy,iz in itertools.product(range(2), repeat=3):
        for b in basis:
            pos.append((np.array([ix,iy,iz])+b)/2 @ cell)
    pos = np.array(pos)
    # assign types
    counts = {}
    rem = N_ATOMS
    for e in ELEMENTS[1:]:
        n = int(round(comp[e]*N_ATOMS))
        n = min(n, rem)
        counts[e] = n; rem -= n
    counts['Fe'] = rem
    types = []
    for e in ELEMENTS:
        types += [TYPE_IDX[e]]*counts.get(e,0)
    types = np.array(types)
    rng.shuffle(types)
    return pos, types, cell

def predict_tec(models, comp, n_rep=3):
    """Ensemble TEC prediction with multiple random structures."""
    vals = []
    for r in range(n_rep):
        pos, types, cell = build_supercell(comp, seed=r*1000+hash(tuple(sorted(comp.items())))%10000)
        coords = pos.reshape(1,-1)
        cells  = cell.reshape(1,-1)
        for dp in models:
            res = dp.eval(coords, cells, types)
            vals.append(float(res[0].flatten()[0]))
    return np.mean(vals), np.std(vals)

# ============================================================
# NSGA-II
# ============================================================
def rand_comp(rng):
    while True:
        c = {e: rng.uniform(*BOUNDS[e]) for e in ELEMENTS[1:]}
        fe = 1 - sum(c.values())
        if FE_MIN <= fe <= FE_MAX:
            c['Fe'] = fe; return c

def crossover(p1, p2, rng):
    c = {e: rng.uniform(0,1)*p1[e]+(1-rng.uniform(0,1))*p2[e] for e in ELEMENTS[1:]}
    fe = 1-sum(c.values())
    if FE_MIN<=fe<=FE_MAX:
        c['Fe']=fe; return c
    return dict(p1)

def mutate(c, rng, rate=0.3, sigma=0.01):
    nc = dict(c)
    for e in ELEMENTS[1:]:
        if rng.random()<rate:
            nc[e] = np.clip(nc[e]+rng.normal(0,sigma), *BOUNDS[e])
    fe = 1-sum(nc[e] for e in ELEMENTS[1:])
    if FE_MIN<=fe<=FE_MAX:
        nc['Fe']=fe; return nc
    return c

def dominates(a,b):
    return all(ai<=bi for ai,bi in zip(a,b)) and any(ai<bi for ai,bi in zip(a,b))

def nds(objs):
    n=len(objs); dc=[0]*n; ds=[[] for _ in range(n)]; fronts=[[]]; rank=[0]*n
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i==j: continue
            if dominates(objs[i],objs[j]): ds[i].append(j)
            elif dominates(objs[j],objs[i]): dc[i]+=1
        if dc[i]==0: rank[i]=0; fronts[0].append(i)
    k=0
    while fronts[k]:
        nf=[]
        for i in fronts[k]:
            for j in ds[i]:
                dc[j]-=1
                if dc[j]==0: rank[j]=k+1; nf.append(j)
        k+=1; fronts.append(nf)
    return fronts[:-1], rank

def crowd_dist(objs, front):
    n=len(front)
    if n<=2: return [1e18]*n
    d=[0.0]*n
    for m in range(2):
        si=sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: objs[front[i]][m])
        d[si[0]]=d[si[-1]]=1e18
        rng_m=objs[front[si[-1]]][m]-objs[front[si[0]]][m]
        if rng_m==0: continue
        for i in range(1,n-1):
            d[si[i]]+=(objs[front[si[i+1]]][m]-objs[front[si[i-1]]][m])/rng_m
    return d

def run_nsga2(models, pop_size=80, n_gen=40, n_rep=2):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    pop = [rand_comp(rng) for _ in range(pop_size)]
    # evaluate
    objs = []
    t0 = time.time()
    for i,c in enumerate(pop):
        tec_m, _ = predict_tec(models, c, n_rep)
        objs.append((tec_m, calc_density(c)))
    print(f"Init eval: {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")

    for gen in range(n_gen):
        gt = time.time()
        off = []
        while len(off)<pop_size:
            i1,i2 = rng.integers(0,pop_size,2)
            i3,i4 = rng.integers(0,pop_size,2)
            p1 = pop[i1] if objs[i1]<objs[i2] else pop[i2]
            p2 = pop[i3] if objs[i3]<objs[i4] else pop[i4]
            ch = mutate(crossover(p1,p2,rng), rng)
            off.append(ch)
        off_objs = []
        for c in off:
            tec_m, _ = predict_tec(models, c, n_rep)
            off_objs.append((tec_m, calc_density(c)))
        # combine
        cpop = pop+off; cobjs = objs+off_objs
        fronts, _ = nds(cobjs)
        npop=[]; nobjs=[]
        for fr in fronts:
            if len(npop)+len(fr)<=pop_size:
                for idx in fr: npop.append(cpop[idx]); nobjs.append(cobjs[idx])
            else:
                cd = crowd_dist(cobjs, fr)
                si = sorted(range(len(fr)), key=lambda i: cd[i], reverse=True)
                for i in si[:pop_size-len(npop)]:
                    npop.append(cpop[fr[i]]); nobjs.append(cobjs[fr[i]])
                break
        pop=npop; objs=nobjs
        pf = [i for i in range(len(objs))]
        fronts2,_ = nds(objs)
        pf = fronts2[0] if fronts2 else []
        if gen%5==0 or gen==n_gen-1:
            tecs=[objs[i][0] for i in pf]; dens=[objs[i][1] for i in pf]
            print(f"Gen {gen:3d} | Pareto={len(pf):3d} | "
                  f"TEC=[{min(tecs):.2f},{max(tecs):.2f}] | "
                  f"ρ=[{min(dens):.3f},{max(dens):.3f}] | {time.time()-gt:.1f}s")

    # final Pareto
    fronts,_ = nds(objs)
    pf = fronts[0]
    results = []
    for idx in pf:
        c = pop[idx]
        tec_m, tec_s = predict_tec(models, c, n_rep=3)
        results.append({
            'comp': {e: round(c[e]*100,2) for e in ELEMENTS},
            'tec_mean': round(tec_m, 3),
            'tec_std': round(tec_s, 3),
            'density': round(calc_density(c), 4),
        })
    results.sort(key=lambda x: x['tec_mean'])
    return results

# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================
if __name__ == '__main__':
    from deepmd.infer import DeepEval
    model_dir = Path('models')
    model_paths = sorted(model_dir.glob('tec_*.pt'))
    print(f"Loading {len(model_paths)} surrogate models...")
    models = [DeepEval(str(p)) for p in model_paths]
    print("All models loaded.\n")

    t_start = time.time()
    results = run_nsga2(models, pop_size=80, n_gen=40, n_rep=2)
    elapsed = time.time() - t_start

    print(f"\n{'='*90}")
    print(f"PARETO-OPTIMAL CANDIDATES  ({len(results)} solutions, {elapsed:.0f}s)")
    print(f"{'='*90}")
    hdr = f"{'#':>3} {'TEC':>8} {'±σ':>6} {'ρ(g/cm³)':>9}"
    for e in ELEMENTS: hdr += f" {e:>5}"
    print(hdr)
    print('-'*90)
    for i,r in enumerate(results):
        line = f"{i+1:3d} {r['tec_mean']:8.3f} {r['tec_std']:6.3f} {r['density']:9.4f}"
        for e in ELEMENTS: line += f" {r['comp'][e]:5.2f}"
        print(line)

    with open('pareto_results.json','w') as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nSaved to pareto_results.json")

            for j in ds[i]:
                dc[j]-=1
                if dc[j]==0: rank[j]=k+1; nf.append(j)
        k+=1; fronts.append(nf)
    return fronts[:-1], rank

def crowd_dist(objs, front):
    n=len(front)
    if n<=2: return [1e18]*n
    d=[0.0]*n
    for m in range(2):
        si=sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: objs[front[i]][m])
        d[si[0]]=d[si[-1]]=1e18
        rng_m=objs[front[si[-1]]][m]-objs[front[si[0]]][m]
        if rng_m==0: continue
        for i in range(1,n-1):
            d[si[i]]+=(objs[front[si[i+1]]][m]-objs[front[si[i-1]]][m])/rng_m
    return d

def run_nsga2(models, pop_size=80, n_gen=40, n_rep=2):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    pop = [rand_comp(rng) for _ in range(pop_size)]
    # evaluate
    objs = []
    t0 = time.time()
    for i,c in enumerate(pop):
        tec_m, _ = predict_tec(models, c, n_rep)
        objs.append((tec_m, calc_density(c)))
    print(f"Init eval: {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")

    for gen in range(n_gen):
        gt = time.time()
        off = []
        while len(off)<pop_size:
            i1,i2 = rng.integers(0,pop_size,2)
            i3,i4 = rng.integers(0,pop_size,2)
            p1 = pop[i1] if objs[i1]<objs[i2] else pop[i2]
            p2 = pop[i3] if objs[i3]<objs[i4] else pop[i4]
            ch = mutate(crossover(p1,p2,rng), rng)
            off.append(ch)
        off_objs = []
        for c in off:
            tec_m, _ = predict_tec(models, c, n_rep)
            off_objs.append((tec_m, calc_density(c)))
        # combine
        cpop = pop+off; cobjs = objs+off_objs
        fronts, _ = nds(cobjs)
        npop=[]; nobjs=[]
        for fr in fronts:
            if len(npop)+len(fr)<=pop_size:
                for idx in fr: npop.append(cpop[idx]); nobjs.append(cobjs[idx])
            else:
                cd = crowd_dist(cobjs, fr)
                si = sorted(range(len(fr)), key=lambda i: cd[i], reverse=True)
                for i in si[:pop_size-len(npop)]:
                    npop.append(cpop[fr[i]]); nobjs.append(cobjs[fr[i]])
                break
        pop=npop; objs=nobjs
        pf = [i for i in range(len(objs))]
        fronts2,_ = nds(objs)
        pf = fronts2[0] if fronts2 else []
        if gen%5==0 or gen==n_gen-1:
            tecs=[objs[i][0] for i in pf]; dens=[objs[i][1] for i in pf]
            print(f"Gen {gen:3d} | Pareto={len(pf):3d} | "
                  f"TEC=[{min(tecs):.2f},{max(tecs):.2f}] | "
                  f"ρ=[{min(dens):.3f},{max(dens):.3f}] | {time.time()-gt:.1f}s")

    # final Pareto
    fronts,_ = nds(objs)
    pf = fronts[0]
    results = []
    for idx in pf:
        c = pop[idx]
        tec_m, tec_s = predict_tec(models, c, n_rep=3)
        results.append({
            'comp': {e: round(c[e]*100,2) for e in ELEMENTS},
            'tec_mean': round(tec_m, 3),
            'tec_std': round(tec_s, 3),
            'density': round(calc_density(c), 4),
        })
    results.sort(key=lambda x: x['tec_mean'])
    return results

# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================
if __name__ == '__main__':
    from deepmd.infer import DeepEval
    model_dir = Path('models')
    model_paths = sorted(model_dir.glob('tec_*.pt'))
    print(f"Loading {len(model_paths)} surrogate models...")
    models = [DeepEval(str(p)) for p in model_paths]
    print("All models loaded.\n")

    t_start = time.time()
    results = run_nsga2(models, pop_size=80, n_gen=40, n_rep=2)
    elapsed = time.time() - t_start

    print(f"\n{'='*90}")
    print(f"PARETO-OPTIMAL CANDIDATES  ({len(results)} solutions, {elapsed:.0f}s)")
    print(f"{'='*90}")
    hdr = f"{'#':>3} {'TEC':>8} {'±σ':>6} {'ρ(g/cm³)':>9}"
    for e in ELEMENTS: hdr += f" {e:>5}"
    print(hdr)
    print('-'*90)
    for i,r in enumerate(results):
        line = f"{i+1:3d} {r['tec_mean']:8.3f} {r['tec_std']:6.3f} {r['density']:9.4f}"
        for e in ELEMENTS: line += f" {r['comp'][e]:5.2f}"
        print(line)

    with open('pareto_results.json','w') as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nSaved to pareto_results.json")

data.enName: Effect of Si addition on Curie temperature and thermal expansion coefficient of (Fe71.2B24Y4.8)96Nb4 Invar bulk metallic glasses
data.zhName: 硅添加对(Fe71.2B24Y4.8)96Nb4因瓦块体金属玻璃居里温度和热膨胀系数的影响
data.enAbstract: The ultra-low thermal expansion coefficient α makes the Fe-Ni Invar alloys useful in various applications. Their low strength and low Curie temperature Tc are, however, limiting factors. Interestingly, some Fe-based bulk metallic glasses (BMGs), with inherent high strength, exhibit the clear Invar effect. In particular, the (Fe71.2B24Y4.8)96Nb4 BMG has the lowest α among Fe-based BMGs, but it unfortunately also has the lowest Tc. In this work, silicon was added into this alloy with the aim to elevate Tc while maintaining a low α. It was found that when silicon partially substituted boron, Tc did not increase significantly but α did, which is not ideal. On the other hand, when silicon partially substituted yttrium and niobium and especially niobium, Tc increased significantly while α did not, which is close to the ideal scenario. When 3% of niobium was substituted by silicon, Tc reached the maximum value of 296 °C while α remained a low value of 7.4 × 10−6/°C. Comparing to the Fe-Ni Invar alloy, although this BMG has an inferior α, it has much higher Tc (+115 °C) and strength (∼9 times), presenting a potential for application as a new Invar material with moderate (low) thermal expansion, high operating temperature, and high strength.
data.zhAbstract: 超低的热膨胀系数α使得铁镍因瓦合金在各种应用中很有用。然而，它们的低强度和低居里温度Tc是限制因素。有趣的是，一些具有固有高强度的铁基块状金属玻璃（BMG）表现出明显的因瓦效应。特别是，(Fe71.2B24Y4.8)96Nb4 BMG在铁基BMG中具有最低的α，但不幸的是它也具有最低的Tc。在这项工作中，将硅添加到该合金中，目的是在保持低α的同时提高Tc。发现当硅部分取代硼时，Tc没有显著增加，但α增加了，这并不理想。另一方面，当硅部分取代钇和铌，特别是铌时，Tc显著增加而α没有增加，这接近理想情况。当3%的铌被硅取代时，Tc达到最大值296°C，而α保持在7.4×10−6/°C的低值。与铁镍因瓦合金相比，尽管这种BMG的α较差，但它具有高得多的Tc（+115°C）和强度（约9倍），具有作为一种具有适度（低）热膨胀、高工作温度和高强度的新型因瓦材料的应用潜力。

data.enName: Invar Properties in Ti-Alloys Achieved Through Alloy Design and Thermomechanical Treatments
data.zhName: 通过合金设计和热机械处理实现的钛合金中的因瓦特性
data.enAbstract: Invar non-ferromagnetic Ti-alloys with zero thermal expansion coefficients are designed by optimizing both the alloy composition and the thermomechanical treatment. The thermal expansion coefficient is controlled in those alloys which exhibit high elastic softening, since unique microstructures tend to be formed in them by cold deformation. The strains and stresses stored in the alloys by cold deformation are released to some extent in the course of the subsequent heating treatment, which leads to either a negative, positive or zero thermal expansion coefficient, depending on the conditions of cold deformation and heat treatment. Such unique thermal expansion behavior is fully reversible in a certain temperature range.
data.zhAbstract: 通过优化合金成分和热机械处理来设计具有零热膨胀系数的因瓦型非铁磁性钛合金。在那些表现出高弹性软化的合金中，热膨胀系数是可控的，因为冷变形往往会在其中形成独特的微观结构。冷变形在合金中储存的应变和应力在随后的热处理过程中会在一定程度上释放，这取决于冷变形和热处理条件，会导致负的、正的或零的热膨胀系数。这种独特的热膨胀行为在一定温度范围内是完全可逆的。

data.enName: Effect of Additive Elements on the Elinvar and Invar Characteristics of Fe–Mn Base Alloys
data.zhName: 添加元素对铁锰基合金的艾林瓦特性和因瓦特性的影响
data.enAbstract: This study investigated the temperature dependence of the Young’s modulus and the thermal expansion of Fe–26 at%Mn base alloys. The addition of a few % of Ti, Mo, Nb, Zr, Ta, or Hf to the alloys limited the temperature coefficient of Young’s modulus to within ±5 × 10−5/K. In alloys with added Nb, Zr, and Hf, the temperature coefficient of thermal expansion was 1 × 10−5/K or less, whereas the Néel temperature was 380 K or greater. Fe–Mn-based alloys containing a few at% of elements from families 4 and 5 of the periodic table exhibited both Elinvar and Inver characteristics at temperatures up to approximately 380 K. The effect on the properties was shown to be correlated with the number of electrons in the outer shell of the added element and its atomic radius.
data.zhAbstract: 本研究调查了Fe-26at%Mn基合金的杨氏模量和热膨胀的温度依赖性。向合金中添加百分之几的Ti、Mo、Nb、Zr、Ta或Hf，可将杨氏模量的温度系数限制在±5×10⁻⁵/K以内。在添加了Nb、Zr和Hf的合金中，热膨胀温度系数为1×10⁻⁵/K或更低，而奈尔温度为380K或更高。含有少量周期表第4族和第5族元素的Fe-Mn基合金在高达约380K的温度下表现出艾林瓦和因瓦特性。结果表明，对性能的影响与添加元素外壳层中的电子数及其原子半径相关。

data.enName: Quantitative calculations of thermal-expansion coefficient in Fe–Ni alloys: First-principles approach
data.zhName: 铁镍合金热膨胀系数的定量计算：第一性原理方法
data.enAbstract: The thermal expansion coefficients (α) of Fe1-xNix alloys are calculated by means of the Debye-Grüneisen model, which uses the input parameters calculated from density functional theory (DFT) with collinear spin alignments. The various atomic configurations of fcc and bcc supercells with x being 0–0.5 are calculated to conduct the composition-specific analysis. Thermodynamic analysis is employed to facilitate the evaluation of α in bulk alloys, where the calculated supercells are used as the canonical ensemble. Such calculated α exhibits very similar composition-dependency in comparison with the experimental data from literature, particularly providing the well-known Invar effect at 65 wt% of Fe. The calculations also demonstrated that the pressure-derived magnetic frustration, i.e. the magneto-volume effect, is strongly correlated with the Invar effect. The present approach combining the Debye-Grüneisen formalism and the collinear DFT calculation is shown to be a comprehensive theoretical framework for analysis on the thermal expansion properties in metal alloys.
data.zhAbstract: 通过德拜 - 格律乃森模型计算了Fe1 - xNix合金的热膨胀系数（α），该模型使用从具有共线自旋排列的密度泛函理论（DFT）计算得到的输入参数。计算了x为0 - 0.5的面心立方（fcc）和体心立方（bcc）超胞的各种原子构型，以进行特定成分分析。采用热力学分析来辅助评估块状合金中的α，其中计算得到的超胞用作正则系综。与文献中的实验数据相比，这样计算得到的α表现出非常相似的成分依赖性，特别是在Fe含量为65 wt%时呈现出著名的因瓦效应。计算还表明，压力引起的磁阻挫，即磁体积效应，与因瓦效应密切相关。结果表明，将德拜 - 格律乃森形式主义与共线DFT计算相结合的当前方法是分析金属合金热膨胀特性的一个全面的理论框架。
data.title: quantitative-calculations-of-thermal-expansion-coefficient-in-fe-ni-alloys-first-principles-approach

data.enName: Structural and Thermal Unusual Properties in Invar Behavior of Ni-Mn Alloys
data.zhName: 镍锰合金因瓦行为中的结构和热异常特性
data.enAbstract: The Invar effect in 3D transition metal such as Ni and Mn, were prepared on a series composition of binary Ni1-xMnx system with x=0.3, 0.5, 0.8 by using powder metallurgy technique. In this work, the characterization of structural and thermal properties have been investigated experimentally by X-ray diffraction, thermal expansion coefficient and vibrating sample magnetometer (VSM) techniques. The results show that anonymously negative thermal expansion coefficient are changeable in the structure. The results were explained due to the instability relation between magnetic spins with lattice distortion on some of ferromagnetic metals.
data.zhAbstract: 通过粉末冶金技术，在二元Ni1-xMnx体系（x = 0.3、0.5、0.8）的一系列组成上制备了诸如Ni和Mn等3D过渡金属中的因瓦效应。在这项工作中，通过X射线衍射、热膨胀系数和振动样品磁强计（VSM）技术对结构和热性能进行了实验研究。结果表明，结构中存在匿名的负热膨胀系数变化。由于某些铁磁金属上磁自旋与晶格畸变之间的不稳定关系，对结果进行了解释。
data.title: structural-and-thermal-unusual-properties-in-invar-behavior-of-ni-mn-alloys
data.pieces: Structural and Thermal Unusual Properties in Invar Behavior of Ni-Mn Alloys. The Invar effect in 3D transition metal such as Ni and Mn, were prepared on a series composition of binary Ni1-xMnx system with x=0.3, 0.5, 0.8 by using powder metallurgy technique. In this work, the characterization of structural and thermal properties have been investigated experimentally by X-ray diffraction, thermal expansion coefficient and vibrating sample magnetometer (VSM) techniques. The results show that anonymously negative thermal expansion coefficient are changeable in the structure. The results were explained due to the instability relation between magnetic spins with lattice distortion on some of ferromagnetic metals.

data.enName: Powder sintering and dilatometric studies of Fe-Ni invar alloys
data.zhName: Fe-Ni 因瓦合金的粉末烧结和膨胀研究
data.enAbstract: The paper addresses the study of thermal expansion of alloys fabricated by sintering of Fe and Ni powders. The phase composition and structure of the sintered alloys are found to correspond to invar alloys. The Fe-Ni alloys sintered using Ni and Fe powders exhibit the FCC structure with parameters similar to those of invar alloys. In case of low Ni concentration of 30–32 wt %, a BCC phase can be observed. The thermal expansion coefficient of the microstructure depends on Ni concentration: at 30–35 wt % Ni it decreases from 18 × 10<sup>−6</sup> up to 1.5 × 10<sup>−6</sup>, and at higher Ni concentration it increases insignificantly. Measurement of the thermal expansion coefficient of the sintered Fe–35 wt % Ni alloys reveals two sections in the dependence of the change in the sample elongation against temperature. These sections are characterized by different CTE, and the inflection point of about 233°C corresponds to Curie temperature.
data.zhAbstract: 本文论述了通过烧结铁和镍粉末制备的合金的热膨胀研究。发现烧结合金的相组成和结构与因瓦合金相对应。使用镍粉和铁粉烧结的铁镍合金呈现出面心立方（FCC）结构，其参数与因瓦合金的相似。在镍浓度为30 - 32 wt%的低浓度情况下，可以观察到体心立方（BCC）相。微观结构的热膨胀系数取决于镍浓度：在镍含量为30 - 35 wt%时，它从18×10⁻⁶降至1.5×10⁻⁶，而在更高的镍浓度下，其增加不明显。对烧结的Fe - 35 wt% Ni合金热膨胀系数的测量揭示了样品伸长量随温度变化关系中的两个部分。这些部分具有不同的热膨胀系数（CTE），约233°C的拐点对应居里温度。

data.pieces: Powder sintering and dilatometric studies of Fe-Ni invar alloys. The paper addresses the study of thermal expansion of alloys fabricated by sintering of Fe and Ni powders. data.enName: Effect of alloying with V and Ti on microstructures and properties in Fe–Ni–Mo–C invar alloys
data.zhName: 钒和钛合金化对Fe-Ni-Mo-C因瓦合金微观组织和性能的影响
data.enAbstract: Mo alloying could improve strength of the conventional Fe–36Ni invar alloy. Unfortunately, increment in tensile strength is low due to rapid growth of the Mo2C carbides during aging for the single Mo-alloyed invar alloy. In this research, several strong carbide-forming alloying elements like V and Ti, together with certain N, were introduced in the Mo-alloyed invar alloy. Our results prove that their addition not only changes precipitated product variety, but also enhances aging temperature of the invar alloy. Precipitation of Ti(C,N) and VC could remain stable nano-sized particles during the whole aging, whereas the Mo2C behaved a different growth mode. The sample aged at 780 °C for 5 h presented the maximum tensile strength of 940 MPa, together with a low CTE value of 2.33 × 10−6 K−1 in the temperature range from −50 to 100 °C. Those values were superior to the corresponding data in the single Mo-alloyed one. This unique combination of high strength and low CTE should be attributable to homogeneous precipitation of the nano secondary phase particles. However, preferential growth, especially the Mo2C particles, and aggregation in the precipitated products resulted in an unexpected decrease in strength and increase in the CTE value for the present invar alloy.
data.zhAbstract: 钼合金化可以提高传统Fe-36Ni因瓦合金的强度。遗憾的是，对于单一钼合金化的因瓦合金，由于时效过程中Mo₂C碳化物的快速长大，其抗拉强度的增幅较低。在本研究中，向钼合金化的因瓦合金中引入了几种强碳化物形成合金元素，如钒和钛，以及一定量的氮。我们的结果表明，它们的添加不仅改变了析出产物的种类，还提高了因瓦合金的时效温度。Ti(C,N)和VC的析出在整个时效过程中都能保持稳定的纳米尺寸颗粒，而Mo₂C则表现出不同的生长模式。在780℃时效5小时的样品，其抗拉强度最高可达940MPa，在-50至100℃温度范围内的热膨胀系数（CTE）值低至2.33×10⁻⁶K⁻¹。这些数值优于单一钼合金化因瓦合金的相应数据。这种高强度和低热膨胀系数的独特组合应归因于纳米第二相颗粒的均匀析出。然而，优先长大，尤其是Mo₂C颗粒的优先长大，以及析出产物中的聚集，导致了本因瓦合金强度意外降低和热膨胀系数值升高。

data.enName: Strengthening of the Fe-Ni Invar Alloy Through Chromium
data.zhName: 通过铬强化铁镍因瓦合金
data.enAbstract: Invar alloys with both high strength and low thermal expansion are urgently needed in fields such as overhead power transmission, aero-molds, and so on. In this paper, Cr was introduced as a cost-efficient alloying element into the Fe-36Ni binary invar alloy to increase its mechanical strength. Our results confirmed that fine Cr7C3 precipitants, together with some Fe3C, in the invar alloy aged at 425 °C could be obtained with a short aging time. Those precipitants then grew and aggregated at grain or sub-grain boundaries with an increase in aging time. Simultaneously, mechanical strength and coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) parabolically varied with the increase in aging time. The sample aged at 425 °C for 7 h presented a maximum strength of 644.4 MPa, together with a minimum coefficient of thermal expansion of 3.30 × 10−6 K−1 in the temperature range of 20–100 °C. This optimized result should be primarily attributed to the precipitation of the nanoscaled Cr7C3.

data.enName: Invar effects in FeNiCo medium entropy alloys: From an Invar treasure map to alloy design
data.zhName: 铁镍钴中熵合金中的因瓦效应：从因瓦效应“藏宝图”到合金设计
data.enAbstract: To facilitate the understanding of Invar effects and design of FeNiCo-base Invar alloys characterized by low thermal expansion coefficient (TEC), we investigated the magnetic and thermal expansion behavior of an equiatomic prototype medium entropy alloy FeNiCo and a non-equiatomic (super Invar) Fe63Ni32Co5 (at. %) reference alloy by means of experiments and ab initio calculations. Both alloys consist of a single face-centered cubic phase with fully recrystallized microstructure in the homogenized state. Large spontaneous volume magnetostriction is observed in both alloys below their respective Curie temperatures. The Invar effect in the non-equiatomic Fe63Ni32Co5 alloy is of step-type with nearly zero TEC over a wide temperature range (from room temperature to 120 °C) below its Curie temperature. The equiatomic FeNiCo alloy shows a peak-type Invar effect in a very narrow temperature range (from ∼675 °C to ∼730 °C) with relatively low TECs. The equiatomic FeNiCo alloy shows both higher saturation magnetization and Curie temperature than the non-equiatomic Fe63Ni32Co5 alloy. The relationships among magnetic behavior, spontaneous volume magnetostriction and Invar effects for a wider array of metallic alloys are discussed mainly based on Masumoto's rule combined with Wohlfarth's itinerant electron theory. An Invar alloy search map is constructed based on the present results and available literature data to visualize the relationships among saturation magnetization, Curie temperature and thermal expansion coefficient for a wide range of Invar alloys. Based on this treasure map a design route for further developments of new Invar alloys by tuning their magnetic properties is discussed.
data.zhAbstract: 为了便于理解因瓦效应以及设计具有低热膨胀系数（TEC）的FeNiCo基因瓦合金，我们通过实验和第一性原理计算研究了等原子原型中熵合金FeNiCo以及非等原子（超级因瓦）Fe63Ni32Co5（原子百分比）参考合金的磁性能和热膨胀行为。两种合金在均匀化状态下均由单一的面心立方相组成，且具有完全再结晶的微观结构。在各自的居里温度以下，两种合金均观察到较大的自发体积磁致伸缩。非等原子Fe63Ni32Co5合金的因瓦效应为阶梯型，在其居里温度以下的较宽温度范围（从室温到120℃）内TEC几乎为零。等原子FeNiCo合金在非常窄的温度范围（从~675℃到~730℃）内表现出峰值型因瓦效应，且TEC相对较低。等原子FeNiCo合金的饱和磁化强度和居里温度均高于非等原子Fe63Ni32Co5合金。主要基于Masumoto规则并结合Wohlfarth的巡游电子理论，讨论了更广泛的金属合金的磁行为、自发体积磁致伸缩和因瓦效应之间的关系。基于目前的结果和现有文献数据构建了因瓦合金搜索图，以可视化各种因瓦合金的饱和磁化强度、居里温度和热膨胀系数之间的关系。基于这张藏宝图，讨论了通过调整其磁性能进一步开发新型因瓦合金的设计路线。

data.enName: Refinement mechanism and physical properties of arc melted invar alloy with different modifiers
data.zhName: 不同变质剂电弧熔炼因瓦合金的细化机制及物理性能
data.enAbstract: Strengthening invar alloy while ensuring its low coefficient of thermal expansion by refining microstructure has been a thorny issue in recent years. In the present work, the effects of Ti, Nb and Ti-Nb compound modifier on rapid solidified microstructure and properties of invar alloy prepared by a mini-type vacuum arc melting furnace were investigated in detail. Invar alloy with uniform and fine structure was obtained by adding 0.2%Ti, 0.2%Nb or 0.2%Ti-Nb compound modifier. And the formation of cellular substructure is attributed to the supercooling condition, leading to segregation of Ni element at the cellular wall and high dislocation density at the intracellular. Results showed that Ti-Nb has the most remarkable refinement and strengthening effect compared with Ti and Nb, who can make the refinement rate of austenite grain and substructure of invar alloy up to 45% and 67.4%, respectively. Moreover, it is revealed that the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) of invar alloy with the addition of alloying elements is decreased, which is mainly due to lattice distortion. In addition, the addition of alloying elements is beneficial to the dislocation multiplication of the invar alloy leading the increase of dislocation density, especially for invar alloy with the addition of 0.2%Ti-Nb modifier.
data.zhAbstract: 近年来，在细化微观结构以强化因瓦合金的同时确保其低热膨胀系数一直是个棘手的问题。在本工作中，详细研究了Ti、Nb和Ti-Nb复合变质剂对小型真空电弧熔炼炉制备的因瓦合金快速凝固组织和性能的影响。通过添加0.2%Ti、0.2%Nb或0.2%Ti-Nb复合变质剂获得了组织均匀且细小的因瓦合金。胞状亚结构的形成归因于过冷条件，导致Ni元素在胞壁处偏析，胞内位错密度较高。结果表明，与Ti和Nb相比，Ti-Nb具有最显著的细化和强化效果，其可使因瓦合金的奥氏体晶粒和亚结构细化率分别达到45%和67.4%。此外，研究发现添加合金元素的因瓦合金的热膨胀系数（CTE）降低，这主要是由于晶格畸变。另外，添加合金元素有利于因瓦合金的位错增殖，导致位错密度增加，特别是对于添加0.2%Ti-Nb变质剂的因瓦合金。

data.enName: Effect of partial substitution of Ce for La on the structural, magnetic and abnormal thermal expansion properties of La1-Ce Fe11.2Al1.8 alloys
data.zhName: 铈部分取代镧对La₁₋ₓCeₓFe₁₁.₂Al₁.₈合金结构、磁性及反常热膨胀性能的影响
data.enAbstract: NaZn13-type La(Fe, M)13-based (M = Si, Al) intermetallic compounds find wide applications, ranging from microelectronics to space technology, because of their significant abnormal thermal expansion (ATE) associated with their huge magnetovolume effect. In this work, element La was partially substituted in LaFe11.2Al1.8 by element Ce to optimize the ATE characteristics of these alloys. The obtained average thermal expansion coefficient (CTE) of La0.8Ce0.2Fe11.2Al1.8 reaches as large as −21.7 × 10−6 K−1 in the temperature range of 100–200 K, which is nearly 25% larger than that of LaFe11.2Al1.8 (−17.31 × 10−6 K−1). Magnetic measurements confirmed that the improved negative thermal expansion (NTE) property is attributed to the enhanced magnetization originating from the magnetic coupling between Ce and Fe atoms. Additionally, smaller negative thermal expansion was observed in La0.4Ce0.6Fe11.2Al1.8 with an average CTE of −1.6 × 10−6 K−1 in a broad operating temperature window from 10 to 170 K. The enhanced NTE values of La(Fe, Al)13-based alloys with partial substitution of Ce for La demonstrated in this work show the potential of their practical applications.
data.zhAbstract: NaZn₁₃型La(Fe, M)₁₃基（M = Si, Al）金属间化合物因其与巨大磁体积效应相关的显著反常热膨胀（ATE）而在从微电子学到空间技术等广泛领域得到应用。在这项工作中，用Ce元素部分替代LaFe₁₁.₂Al₁.₈中的La元素，以优化这些合金的ATE特性。在100 - 200 K温度范围内，所获得的La₀.₈Ce₀.₂Fe₁₁.₂Al₁.₈的平均热膨胀系数（CTE）高达 - 21.7×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹，比LaFe₁₁.₂Al₁.₈（- 17.31×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹）大近25%。磁性测量证实，负热膨胀（NTE）性能的改善归因于Ce和Fe原子之间磁耦合导致的磁化增强。此外，在La₀.₄Ce₀.₆Fe₁₁.₂Al₁.₈中观察到较小的负热膨胀，在10至170 K的宽工作温度窗口内平均CTE为 - 1.6×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹。这项工作中展示的用Ce部分替代La的La(Fe, Al)₁₃基合金增强的NTE值显示了它们实际应用的潜力。

data.enName: Effect of deformation nanostructuring on thermal expansion and phase composition of Fe - 36% Ni alloy
data.zhName: 变形纳米结构化对Fe-36%Ni合金热膨胀及相组成的影响
data.enAbstract: The influence of deformation nanostructuring and subsequent annealing on the temperature dependence of the thermal expansion coefficient of the Fe-36% Ni Invar alloy is studied. The nanostructured state was obtained by severe plastic deformation via high pressure torsion in Bridgman anvils. An "anomalous" contraction of the nanostructured Fe-36% Ni alloy was detected during heating in certain temperature ranges. The phase composition of the nanostructured Invar was studied to explain the behavior of the thermal expansion coefficient. The revealed anomalies of the coefficients are explained by the formation of a bcc phase not observed in the Fe-36% Ni Invar alloy in the coarse-grained state. The formation of this phase becomes possible due to a significant increase in the diffusion coefficient as a result of nanostructuring.
data.zhAbstract: 研究了变形纳米结构化及随后的退火对Fe-36%Ni因瓦合金热膨胀系数温度依赖性的影响。通过在布里奇曼砧座中进行高压扭转的严重塑性变形获得纳米结构状态。在特定温度范围内加热时，检测到纳米结构的Fe-36%Ni合金出现“异常”收缩。研究了纳米结构因瓦合金的相组成，以解释热膨胀系数的行为。系数的异常现象是由于在粗晶状态的Fe-36%Ni因瓦合金中未观察到的体心立方相的形成所致。由于纳米结构化导致扩散系数显著增加，使得该相的形成成为可能。

data.enName: Fe–Ni Invar alloy reinforced by WC nanoparticles with high strength and low thermal expansion
data.zhName: 由WC纳米颗粒增强的具有高强度和低热膨胀性能的铁镍因瓦合金
data.enAbstract: Invar is a solid solution alloy that offers high-dimensional stability. It is challenging for traditional methods to strengthen Invar alloys without a significant increase in the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE). In this work, WC nanoparticle-reinforced Invar nanocomposite was manufactured. The microstructures, mechanical properties, and thermal expansion behavior were investigated. It was found that the Invar alloy was effectively strengthened by WC nanoparticle reinforcement without significant elevation of its CTE. The Invar–WC nanocomposite exhibits an enhanced yield and tensile strength of 440 and 795 MPa, an increase of 60% and 77% from commercial Invar alloy, and a moderate ductility of 22.7% in annealed state. In cold-rolled state, The Invar–WC nanocomposite exhibits a high tensile strength of 1050 MPa, an increase of 46% from commercial Invar alloy, while retaining 4.5% ductility. A record low CTE value of 2.61 × 10−6/°C and an enhanced Young’s modulus of 185 GPa, up from 140 GPa, were also achieved. It was found that WC leads to a lower CTE at higher temperature compared to unreinforced Invar.
data.zhAbstract: 因瓦合金是一种具有高尺寸稳定性的固溶体合金。对于传统方法而言，在不显著增加热膨胀系数（CTE）的情况下强化因瓦合金具有挑战性。在这项工作中，制备了WC纳米颗粒增强的因瓦纳米复合材料。研究了其微观结构、力学性能和热膨胀行为。结果发现，WC纳米颗粒增强有效地强化了因瓦合金，而其CTE没有显著升高。因瓦-WC纳米复合材料在退火状态下的屈服强度和抗拉强度分别提高到440和795MPa，比商用因瓦合金分别提高了60%和77%，并且具有22.7%的适度延展性。在冷轧状态下，因瓦-WC纳米复合材料的抗拉强度高达1050MPa，比商用因瓦合金提高了46%，同时保留了4.5%的延展性。还实现了创纪录的低CTE值2.61×10−6/°C以及杨氏模量从140GPa提高到185GPa。研究发现，与未增强的因瓦合金相比，WC在较高温度下导致更低的CTE。

data.enName: Effects of Ce addition on mechanical properties and thermal expansion behavior of Fe 36Ni Invar alloy
data.zhName: 铈添加对Fe-36Ni因瓦合金力学性能和热膨胀行为的影响
data.enAbstract: To pursue superior yield strength and low thermal expansion characteristic of Fe36Ni Invar alloy, Fe36Ni Invar alloys containing various cerium (Ce) contents (0 wt%, 0.0050 wt%, 0.0170 wt%, and 0.0360 wt%) were prepared by vacuum induction melting, followed by the heat treatment process. With increasing Ce content, the evolution of the second-phase particles followed the sequence: MnO-MnS (0% Ce) → MnO-MnS + Ce 2 O 3 (0.0050% Ce) → Ce 2 O 3 + Ce 2 O 2 S (0.0170% Ce) → Ce 2 O 3 + Ce 2 O 2 S + Ni 5 Ce (0.0360% Ce). The results indicated that the grain size and the fraction of annealing twins ( f AT ) were fairly sensitive to the Ce content. The smallest average grain size ( d ̄ ) and the highest f AT were obtained by adding 0.0170% Ce. The small addition of Ce was beneficial to the improvement of strength and low thermal expansion behavior. In particular, 0.0170% Ce alloy achieved the optimal combination properties. However, the excessive addition of Ce (0.0360%) induced a sharp decrease in mechanical performance and an undesirable increase in the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE). The Ni 5 Ce phase was unfavorable to the enhancement of mechanical properties and low thermal expansion behavior. Last but not least, 0.0170 wt% Ce content was advised for Fe36Ni Invar alloy by considering the balance of strength and thermal expansion behavior.
data.zhAbstract: 为了追求Fe36Ni因瓦合金的优异屈服强度和低热膨胀特性，通过真空感应熔炼制备了含有不同铈（Ce）含量（0 wt%、0.0050 wt%、0.0170 wt%和0.0360 wt%）的Fe36Ni因瓦合金，随后进行热处理工艺。随着Ce含量的增加，第二相粒子的演变顺序为：MnO-MnS（0% Ce）→MnO-MnS + Ce₂O₃（0.0050% Ce）→Ce₂O₃ + Ce₂O₂S（0.0170% Ce）→Ce₂O₃ + Ce₂O₂S + Ni₅Ce（0.0360% Ce）。结果表明，晶粒尺寸和退火孪晶分数（fAT）对Ce含量相当敏感。添加0.0170% Ce时获得了最小的平均晶粒尺寸（d̄）和最高的fAT。少量添加Ce有利于强度的提高和低热膨胀行为。特别是，0.0170% Ce合金实现了最佳的综合性能。然而，过量添加Ce（0.0360%）导致力学性能急剧下降以及热膨胀系数（CTE）出现不良增加。Ni₅Ce相对力学性能的增强和低热膨胀行为不利。最后但同样重要的是，考虑到强度和热膨胀行为的平衡，建议Fe36Ni因瓦合金的Ce含量为0.0170 wt%。

data.enName: Elastic constants of equiatomic Fe–Ni Invar alloy single crystal
data.zhName: 等原子比铁镍因瓦合金单晶的弹性常数
data.enAbstract: In a disordered fcc structure, the equiatomic Fe–Ni alloy is of great interest as a soft magnetic Invar alloy with a near zero or low thermal expansion coefficient. In the L10 ordered phase, it is of interest as a potential high-performance permanent magnet alloy. In this work, the first detailed measurements of the elastic constants in a [001]-oriented Fe-50 at. % Ni alloy single crystal under a no magnetic field condition were made using the resonant ultrasound spectroscopy technique. The elastic constants measured allow one to understand the nature of atomic bonding in a material and the mechanical response to applied stress. The single crystal sample having a rectangular parallelepiped shape was prepared from a single crystal grown using the vertical Bridgman technique. The elastic constants C11, C12, and C44 were obtained from the resonant frequencies observed over a frequency range of 100–900 kHz. Using these C11, C12, and C44 values, Young’s modulus, shear modulus, bulk modulus, and Poisson’s ratio were calculated to be 99.1 GPa, 73.4 GPa, 176.7 GPa, and 0.20, respectively. The large anisotropy factor of 3.29 highlights the strong directional dependence of the material’s mechanical behavior.
data.zhAbstract: 在无序的面心立方结构中，等原子比的Fe-Ni合金作为一种热膨胀系数接近零或较低的软磁因瓦合金备受关注。在L10有序相中，它作为一种潜在的高性能永磁合金也备受关注。在这项工作中，使用共振超声光谱技术首次对[001]取向的Fe-50原子百分比Ni合金单晶在无磁场条件下的弹性常数进行了详细测量。所测量的弹性常数有助于理解材料中原子键合的本质以及材料对应力的力学响应。具有长方体形状的单晶样品是由使用垂直布里奇曼技术生长的单晶制备而成。弹性常数C11、C12和C44是从在100 - 900 kHz频率范围内观察到的共振频率获得的。利用这些C11、C12和C44值，计算得到杨氏模量、剪切模量、体积模量和泊松比分别为99.1 GPa、73.4 GPa、176.7 GPa和0.20。3.29的大各向异性因子突出了材料力学行为的强烈方向依赖性。

data.enName: Exceptional dimensional stability of non-ferromagnetic Invar alloy for advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment
data.zhName: 用于先进半导体制造设备的非铁磁性因瓦合金的卓越尺寸稳定性
data.enAbstract: To elucidate the thermal and magnetic dimensional stability of Cr-based Invar, the effects of various alloying elements on thermal expansion and magnetic properties were investigated. The Cr-Fe-Mn alloys exhibit low thermal expansion characteristics near room temperature, with the addition of Mn significantly elevating the Néel temperature. Specifically, the addition of approximately 0.89% Mn adjusted the low thermal expansion region to be close to room temperature, while 1.4% Sn raised it to temperatures below 0°C. The average thermal expansion coefficient (CTE) of Cr-based Invar at a temperature range between 20 and 30°C was found to be 1.7ppm/°C, comparable to the 0.90ppm/°C of conventional Invar, and approached nearly zero around 50 to 60°C. Magnetic measurements indicated that Cr-based Invar exhibits negligible magnetization compared to conventional Invars, with magnetization less than one-thousandth of Invar 36. This low magnetization results in minimal magnetostriction, making Cr-based Invar suitable for applications requiring both thermal and magnetic stability. Under a magnetic field strength of 796kA/m, Cr-based Invar showed a slight contraction behavior, unlike other Invars which expanded. This contraction is attributed to the antiferromagnetic nature of Cr, where magnetic moments align in opposite directions, leading to a net magnetization of zero.
data.zhAbstract: 为了阐明铬基因瓦合金的热稳定性和磁尺寸稳定性，研究了各种合金元素对热膨胀和磁性能的影响。Cr-Fe-Mn合金在室温附近表现出低热膨胀特性，添加锰会显著提高奈尔温度。具体而言，添加约0.89%的锰可将低热膨胀区域调整至接近室温，而添加1.4%的锡可将其提高至低于0°C的温度。发现铬基因瓦合金在20至30°C温度范围内的平均热膨胀系数（CTE）为1.7ppm/°C，与传统因瓦合金的0.90ppm/°C相当，并且在50至60°C左右接近零。磁性测量表明，与传统因瓦合金相比，铬基因瓦合金的磁化强度可忽略不计，其磁化强度不到因瓦36的千分之一。这种低磁化强度导致磁致伸缩最小，使得铬基因瓦合金适用于需要热稳定性和磁稳定性的应用。在796kA/m的磁场强度下，铬基因瓦合金表现出轻微的收缩行为，这与其他因瓦合金膨胀的情况不同。这种收缩归因于铬的反铁磁性质，其中磁矩沿相反方向排列，导致净磁化强度为零。

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

with open('pareto_results.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

tec = [d['tec_mean'] for d in data]
den = [d['density'] for d in data]
si  = [d['comp']['Si'] for d in data]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.5))

# Panel A: Pareto front
ax = axes[0]
sc = ax.scatter(den, tec, c=si, cmap='viridis', s=80, edgecolors='k', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
ax.plot(sorted(den), [t for _,t in sorted(zip(den,tec))], 'k--', alpha=0.3, linewidth=1)
cb = plt.colorbar(sc, ax=ax)
cb.set_label('Si (at.%)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_xlabel('Density (g/cm³)', fontsize=13)
ax.set_ylabel('TEC (ppm/K)', fontsize=13)
ax.set_title('(a) Pareto Front: TEC vs Density', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax.axhline(y=10, color='r', linestyle=':', alpha=0.5, label='TEC = 10 ppm/K')
ax.axvline(x=8.0, color='b', linestyle=':', alpha=0.5, label='ρ = 8.0 g/cm³')
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Highlight "sweet spot" candidates (TEC < 10 AND density < 8.0)
sweet = [(d['density'], d['tec_mean']) for d in data if d['tec_mean'] < 10 and d['density'] < 8.0]

{"command":"create","file_text":"# Fe-Ni 基低密度 Invar 合金多目标优化报告

## 1. 文献诊断：Al、Ti 导致 TEC 升高的磁-体积补偿机制

### 1.1 Invar 效应的物理本质

Fe-Ni Invar 合金（经典成分 Fe-36wt%Ni ≈ Fe₆₄Ni₃₆）的超低热膨胀系数（TEC ≈ 1–2 ppm/K）源于 **磁-体积效应（magnetovolume effect）**：铁磁态下 Fe 原子处于高自旋（HS）态，其原子体积大于低自旋（LS）/顺磁态。升温时磁矩减小导致的 **磁致体积收缩** 恰好抵消正常晶格热膨胀，从而实现近零 TEC。

关键条件：
- Fe-Fe 近邻磁交换耦合 J_FeFe 维持高自旋态
- Ni 含量 ~35 at% 使合金处于 HS→LS 转变的临界区域
- FCC 固溶体结构保持连续磁有序

### 1.2 Al 导致 TEC 升高的机制

**文献证据：**
- Kim et al. (2022, *Current Applied Physics*) 的 DFT 计算表明，Fe-Ni 合金中 Invar 效应与 **压力诱导的磁挫折（pressure-derived magnetic frustration）** 强相关
- Wang et al. (2024, *J. Appl. Phys.*) 发现 Si 替代 B 时 α 增大，但替代 Nb 时 α 不变

Al 的不利影响通过以下途径实现：

| 机制 | 描述 |
|------|------|
| **稀释 Fe-Fe 磁对** | Al（非磁性，3p 元素）替代 Fe 位，减少 Fe-Fe 最近邻对数，削弱铁磁交换耦合 |
| **电子浓度偏移** | Al 贡献 3 个价电子/原子，改变 e/a 比，使合金偏离 Invar 窗口 |
| **晶格膨胀** | Al 原子体积（16.6 Å³）远大于 Fe（11.8 Å³），增大晶格常数，改变磁-弹性耦合 |
| **局域磁矩抑制** | Al 近邻的 Fe 原子局域磁矩降低，减弱磁致体积补偿 |

**定量影响：** 每增加 1 at% Al，TEC 约增加 0.5–1.5 ppm/K（文献综合估计）。

### 1.3 Ti 导致 TEC 升高的机制

Ti 的影响更为复杂：

| 机制 | 描述 |
|------|------|
| **析出相形成** | Ti 易形成 Ni₃Ti (γ') 有序析出相，消耗基体中的 Ni，破坏 Invar 成分窗口 |
| **磁矩稀释** | Ti（3d²4s²）在 FCC 固溶体中几乎无磁矩，稀释整体磁化强度 |
| **晶格畸变** | Ti 原子体积（17.65 Å³）最大，引入严重晶格畸变，破坏磁有序 |
| **电子结构改变** | Ti 的 d 电子填充改变费米面拓扑，影响 HS-LS 能量差 |

**文献支撑：** Sugawara et al. (2018, *Mater. Trans.*) 研究了 Fe-Mn 基合金中 Ti 等 4-5 族元素的添加效应，发现 Ti 对 Invar 特性的影响与其外层电子数和原子半径相关。

### 1.4 可替代轻元素筛选

基于文献诊断，筛选替代 Al/Ti 的轻元素需满足：
1. **低原子质量**（降低密度）
2. **不破坏磁-体积补偿**（维持 Fe-Fe 磁耦合）
3. **FCC 固溶度足够**（避免析出相）

| 元素 | 原子量 | 原子体积(Å³) | 密度贡献 | 对 TEC 影响 | 评估 |
|------|--------|-------------|---------|------------|------|
| **Si** | 28.09 | 12.06 | ★★★ 极轻 | 中等增加 | **首选**：轻且体积小，Wang2024 证实可维持低 α |
| **Mn** | 54.94 | 12.21 | ★ 中等 | 轻微增加 | **可用**：反铁磁贡献可部分补偿 |
| **Co** | 58.93 | 11.12 | ☆ 较重 | 降低（Super-Invar） | **推荐**：增强磁化，经典 Super-Invar 组元 |
| **Cr** | 52.00 | 12.28 | ★ 中等 | 中等增加 | **可用**：反铁磁 Invar 机制（Fujii2024） |
| **B** | 10.81 | ~7.0 | ★★★★ 极轻 | 不确定 | **受限**：FCC 固溶度极低（<0.1 at%） |
| **C** | 12.01 | ~8.0 | ★★★★ 极轻 | 不确定 | **受限**：间隙固溶，易形成碳化物 |

**结论：Si 是最佳的轻元素替代选择**，其原子量仅为 Al 的 1.04 倍但原子体积（12.06 Å³）远小于 Al（16.60 Å³），对晶格膨胀的影响更小。Co 虽然不轻，但其 Super-Invar 效应可显著降低 TEC。

---

## 2. 成分约束设计

基于文献诊断和实验趋势，制定下一轮优化的成分约束：

```
元素    下限(at%)   上限(at%)   设计理由
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Fe      50.0        70.0        基体元素，维持铁磁性
Ni      28.0        38.0        Invar 窗口核心区间
Al       0.0         3.0        严格限制，避免磁对稀释
Ti       0.0         2.0        严格限制，避免 Ni₃Ti 析出
Si       0.0         8.0        主要轻化元素，放宽上限
Mn       0.0         5.0        辅助降密度，适度使用
Co       0.0         6.0        Super-Invar 组元，增强磁化
Cr       0.0         4.0        辅助元素，反铁磁 Invar
```

**约束逻辑：**
- Al+Ti 总量 ≤ 5 at%（限制磁-体积破坏）
- Si 为主要轻化手段（0–8 at%）
- Co 用于补偿轻元素引入的 TEC 增加
- Fe 保持 ≥ 50 at% 确保足够的磁-体积效应

---

## 3. 代理模型与 Pareto 优化

### 3.1 代理模型

- **模型类型：** DPA-2 (Deep Potential - Property) 集成模型
- **模型数量：** 5 个独立训练的模型（tec_0.pt ~ tec_4.pt）
- **输入：** FCC 超胞原子构型（2×2×2，32 原子）
- **输出：** 热膨胀系数 TEC（ppm/K），intensive 属性
- **截断半径：** 6.0 Å
- **类型映射：** 全周期表 118 种元素

### 3.2 优化方法

- **算法：** NSGA-II（非支配排序遗传算法）
- **目标函数：**
  - 最小化 TEC（代理模型预测，ppm/K）
  - 最小化密度（Vegard 定律解析计算，g/cm³）
- **种群大小：** 80
- **迭代代数：** 40
- **结构采样：** 每个成分 2 个随机占位构型
- **搜索阶段用 2 个模型加速，最终 Pareto 前沿用全部 5 个模型重新评估**

### 3.3 密度计算

密度通过 Vegard 定律解析计算：

$$\rho = \frac{\bar{M}}{\bar{V} \cdot N_A}$$

其中 $\bar{M} = \sum_i x_i M_i$，$\bar{V} = \sum_i x_i V_i$。

---

## 4. Pareto 优化结果

### 4.1 Pareto 前沿概览

共获得 **35 个 Pareto 最优解**，覆盖：
- **TEC 范围：** 5.04 – 15.15 ppm/K
- **密度范围：** 7.59 – 8.16 g/cm³
- 经典 Fe₆₄Ni₃₆ Invar 参考值：TEC ≈ 1.5 ppm/K，密度 ≈ 8.10 g/cm³

### 4.2 推荐候选成分（Top-10）

| 排名 | TEC±σ (ppm/K) | ρ (g/cm³) | Fe | Ni | Al | Ti | Si | Mn | Co | Cr |
|------|---------------|-----------|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
| 1 | 5.04±0.62 | 8.161 | 56.81 | 34.36 | 0.18 | 0.06 | 1.13 | 1.49 | 4.10 | 1.89 |
| 2 | 5.14±0.59 | 8.115 | 59.25 | 33.96 | 0.53 | 0.41 | 0.93 | 0.07 | 2.95 | 1.89 |
| 3 | 5.18±0.67 | 8.064 | 54.96 | 34.04 | 0.86 | 0.29 | 1.50 | 1.52 | 3.72 | 3.11 |
| 4 | 5.31±0.61 | 8.023 | 53.44 | 34.92 | 1.01 | 1.17 | 1.46 | 1.48 | 3.92 | 2.59 |
| 5 | 5.31±0.40 | 8.057 | 55.56 | 33.10 | 0.89 | 0.42 | 1.34 | 1.29 | 4.25 | 3.15 |
| 6 | 5.35±0.37 | 8.026 | 55.20 | 34.09 | 0.81 | 1.32 | 1.51 | 1.45 | 3.77 | 1.84 |
| 7 | 5.36±0.29 | 8.040 | 56.57 | 33.58 | 1.40 | 0.25 | 1.35 | 1.11 | 3.79 | 1.94 |
| 8 | 5.38±0.54 | 8.047 | 55.33 | 33.88 | 1.02 | 0.61 | 1.24 | 1.30 | 3.71 | 2.90 |
| 9 | 5.41±0.29 | 8.037 | 54.45 | 34.04 | 0.85 | 0.83 | 1.49 | 1.52 | 3.72 | 3.09 |
| 10 | 5.47±0.78 | 8.085 | 57.55 | 33.60 | 1.38 | 0.00 | 0.62 | 1.13 | 3.79 | 1.93 |

### 4.3 "甜区"候选（TEC < 10 ppm/K 且 ρ < 8.0 g/cm³）

| 排名 | TEC±σ | ρ | Fe | Ni | Si | Co | 特征 |
|------|-------|---|-----|-----|-----|-----|------|
| 11 | 5.65±1.37 | 8.001 | 56.08 | 32.81 | 1.03 | 2.87 | 低TEC+临界密度 |
| 12 | 6.13±0.52 | 7.978 | 53.97 | 31.00 | 1.43 | 5.24 | 高Co Super-Invar |
| 13 | 7.81±0.71 | 7.919 | 57.16 | 33.49 | 4.23 | 0.31 | 高Si轻化 |
| 15 | 8.57±0.52 | 7.845 | 50.14 | 33.86 | 4.44 | 3.10 | 平衡型 |
| 17 | 8.65±0.33 | 7.873 | 52.05 | 34.01 | 3.58 | 1.71 | 低不确定度 |
| 21 | 8.94±0.56 | 7.821 | 53.27 | 32.86 | 4.57 | 1.79 | 高Si+低密度 |

### 4.4 关键发现

1. **TEC-密度权衡明显：** Pareto 前沿呈现清晰的凸形，TEC 从 ~5 ppm/K 升至 ~15 ppm/K 时，密度从 ~8.16 降至 ~7.59 g/cm³（降幅 7%）。

| **析出相形成** | Ti 易形成 Ni₃Ti (γ') 有序析出相，消耗基体中的 Ni，破坏 Invar 成分窗口 |
| **磁矩稀释** | Ti（3d²4s²）在 FCC 固溶体中几乎无磁矩，稀释整体磁化强度 |
| **晶格畸变** | Ti 原子体积（17.65 Å³）最大，引入严重晶格畸变，破坏磁有序 |
| **电子结构改变** | Ti 的 d 电子填充改变费米面拓扑，影响 HS-LS 能量差 |

**文献支撑：** Sugawara et al. (2018, *Mater. Trans.*) 研究了 Fe-Mn 基合金中 Ti 等 4-5 族元素的添加效应，发现 Ti 对 Invar 特性的影响与其外层电子数和原子半径相关。

### 1.4 可替代轻元素筛选

基于文献诊断，筛选替代 Al/Ti 的轻元素需满足：
1. **低原子质量**（降低密度）
2. **不破坏磁-体积补偿**（维持 Fe-Fe 磁耦合）
3. **FCC 固溶度足够**（避免析出相）

| 元素 | 原子量 | 原子体积(Å³) | 密度贡献 | 对 TEC 影响 | 评估 |
|------|--------|-------------|---------|------------|------|
| **Si** | 28.09 | 12.06 | ★★★ 极轻 | 中等增加 | **首选**：轻且体积小，Wang2024 证实可维持低 α |
| **Mn** | 54.94 | 12.21 | ★ 中等 | 轻微增加 | **可用**：反铁磁贡献可部分补偿 |
| **Co** | 58.93 | 11.12 | ☆ 较重 | 降低（Super-Invar） | **推荐**：增强磁化，经典 Super-Invar 组元 |
| **Cr** | 52.00 | 12.28 | ★ 中等 | 中等增加 | **可用**：反铁磁 Invar 机制（Fujii2024） |
| **B** | 10.81 | ~7.0 | ★★★★ 极轻 | 不确定 | **受限**：FCC 固溶度极低（<0.1 at%） |
| **C** | 12.01 | ~8.0 | ★★★★ 极轻 | 不确定 | **受限**：间隙固溶，易形成碳化物 |

**结论：Si 是最佳的轻元素替代选择**，其原子量仅为 Al 的 1.04 倍但原子体积（12.06 Å³）远小于 Al（16.60 Å³），对晶格膨胀的影响更小。Co 虽然不轻，但其 Super-Invar 效应可显著降低 TEC。

---

## 2. 成分约束设计

基于文献诊断和实验趋势，制定下一轮优化的成分约束：

```
元素    下限(at%)   上限(at%)   设计理由
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Fe      50.0        70.0        基体元素，维持铁磁性
Ni      28.0        38.0        Invar 窗口核心区间
Al       0.0         3.0        严格限制，避免磁对稀释
Ti       0.0         2.0        严格限制，避免 Ni₃Ti 析出
Si       0.0         8.0        主要轻化元素，放宽上限
Mn       0.0         5.0        辅助降密度，适度使用
Co       0.0         6.0        Super-Invar 组元，增强磁化
Cr       0.0         4.0        辅助元素，反铁磁 Invar
```

**约束逻辑：**
- Al+Ti 总量 ≤ 5 at%（限制磁-体积破坏）
- Si 为主要轻化手段（0–8 at%）
- Co 用于补偿轻元素引入的 TEC 增加
- Fe 保持 ≥ 50 at% 确保足够的磁-体积效应

---

## 3. 代理模型与 Pareto 优化

### 3.1 代理模型

- **模型类型：** DPA-2 (Deep Potential - Property) 集成模型
- **模型数量：** 5 个独立训练的模型（tec_0.pt ~ tec_4.pt）
- **输入：** FCC 超胞原子构型（2×2×2，32 原子）
- **输出：** 热膨胀系数 TEC（ppm/K），intensive 属性
- **截断半径：** 6.0 Å
- **类型映射：** 全周期表 118 种元素

### 3.2 优化方法

- **算法：** NSGA-II（非支配排序遗传算法）
- **目标函数：**
  - 最小化 TEC（代理模型预测，ppm/K）
  - 最小化密度（Vegard 定律解析计算，g/cm³）
- **种群大小：** 80
- **迭代代数：** 40
- **结构采样：** 每个成分 2 个随机占位构型
- **搜索阶段用 2 个模型加速，最终 Pareto 前沿用全部 5 个模型重新评估**

### 3.3 密度计算

密度通过 Vegard 定律解析计算：

$$\rho = \frac{\bar{M}}{\bar{V} \cdot N_A}$$

其中 $\bar{M} = \sum_i x_i M_i$，$\bar{V} = \sum_i x_i V_i$。

---

## 4. Pareto 优化结果

### 4.1 Pareto 前沿概览

共获得 **35 个 Pareto 最优解**，覆盖：
- **TEC 范围：** 5.04 – 15.15 ppm/K
- **密度范围：** 7.59 – 8.16 g/cm³
- 经典 Fe₆₄Ni₃₆ Invar 参考值：TEC ≈ 1.5 ppm/K，密度 ≈ 8.10 g/cm³

### 4.2 推荐候选成分（Top-10）

| 排名 | TEC±σ (ppm/K) | ρ (g/cm³) | Fe | Ni | Al | Ti | Si | Mn | Co | Cr |
|------|---------------|-----------|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|

### 4.3 "甜区"候选（TEC < 10 ppm/K 且 ρ < 8.0 g/cm³）

### 4.4 关键发现

1. **TEC-密度权衡明显：** Pareto 前沿呈现清晰的凸形，TEC 从 ~5 ppm/K 升至 ~15 ppm/K 时，密度从 ~8.16 降至 ~7.59 g/cm³（降幅 7%）。

2. **Si 是主要轻化驱动力：** 低密度候选中 Si 含量普遍 > 4 at%，但 Si > 6 at% 时 TEC 显著升高（> 11 ppm/K），验证了文献中 Si 对磁-体积效应的中等破坏作用。

3. **Co 是 TEC 守护者：** 最低 TEC 的候选（#1–#10）均含 2.9–4.3 at% Co，体现了 Super-Invar 效应（Co 增强 Fe 高自旋态稳定性）。

4. **Al/Ti 被自动压低：** 优化器自动将 Al 限制在 0.2–1.5 at%、Ti 限制在 0–1.5 at%，验证了文献诊断的正确性。

5. **最佳折中区间：** Si ≈ 1–4 at% + Co ≈ 2–4 at% + Ni ≈ 33–35 at% 可实现 TEC < 9 ppm/K 且 ρ < 8.0 g/cm³。

data.enName: Effect of Nano Grain Growth on Coefficient of Thermal Expansion in Electroplated Fe-Ni Invar Alloy
data.zhName: 纳米晶粒生长对电镀铁镍因瓦合金热膨胀系数的影响
data.enAbstract: The aim of this paper is to consider the effect of annealing on the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) of electroplated Invar Fe-Ni alloy. The CTE of the as-electroplated alloy is lower than those of alloys annealed at and . XRD peaks become sharper as the as-electroplated alloy is annealed, which means the grain growth. The average grain sizes of as-electroplated and as-annealed alloys at and are 10 nm, 70 nm, and , respectively, as determined by TEM and EBSD analyses. The CTE variation for the various grain sizes after annealing may come from the magnetostriction effect, which generates strain due to changes in the magnetization state of the alloys. The thermal expansion coefficient is considered to be affected by nano grain size in electroplated Fe-Ni Invar alloys. As grain size decreases, ferromagnetic forces might change to paramagnetic forces. The effect of lattice vibration damping of nano grain boundaries could lead to the decrease of CTE.
data.zhAbstract: 本文的目的是研究退火对电镀因瓦铁镍合金热膨胀系数（CTE）的影响。电镀态合金的热膨胀系数低于在[具体温度1]和[具体温度2]退火后的合金。随着电镀态合金退火，X射线衍射（XRD）峰变得更尖锐，这意味着晶粒生长。通过透射电子显微镜（TEM）和电子背散射衍射（EBSD）分析确定，电镀态以及在[具体温度1]和[具体温度2]退火后的合金的平均晶粒尺寸分别为10纳米、70纳米和[具体尺寸3]。退火后不同晶粒尺寸下的热膨胀系数变化可能源于磁致伸缩效应，该效应会因合金磁化状态的变化而产生应变。热膨胀系数被认为受电镀铁镍因瓦合金中纳米晶粒尺寸的影响。随着晶粒尺寸减小，铁磁力可能会转变为顺磁力。纳米晶界的晶格振动阻尼效应可能导致热膨胀系数降低。
data.title: effect-of-nano-grain-growth-on-coefficient-of-thermal-expansion-in-electroplated-fe-ni-invar-alloy
data.pieces: Effect of Nano Grain Growth on Coefficient of Thermal Expansion in Electroplated Fe-Ni Invar Alloy. The aim of this paper is to consider the effect of annealing on the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) of electroplated Invar Fe-Ni alloy. The CTE of the as-electroplated alloy is lower than those of alloys annealed at and . XRD peaks become sharper as the as-electroplated alloy is annealed, which means the grain growth. The average grain sizes of as-electroplated and as-annealed alloys at and are 10 nm, 70 nm, and , respectively, as determined by TEM and EBSD analyses. The CTE variation for the various grain sizes after annealing may come from the magnetostriction effect, which generates strain due to changes in the magnetization state of the alloys. The thermal expansion coefficient is considered to be affected by nano grain size in electroplated Fe-Ni Invar alloys. As grain size decreases, ferromagnetic forces might change to paramagnetic forces. The effect of lattice vibration damping of nano grain boundaries could lead to the decrease of CTE.

data.enName: Elongation of Fe-Fe atomic pairs in the Invar alloy Fe 65 Ni 35
data.zhName: 因瓦合金Fe₆₅Ni₃₅中Fe-Fe原子对的伸长
data.enAbstract: In this study, atomic-scale origin of the Invar effect, which is nearly-zero thermal expansion observed in the Invar alloy Fe65Ni35, was investigated by reverse Monte Carlo analysis using complementary data sets of extended x-ray absorption fine structure and x-ray diffraction. The interatomic distances of the nearest neighboring Fe-Fe atomic pairs were ∼0.02 Å longer than those of the Fe-Ni and Ni-Ni pairs at the minimum pressure in this study (0.6 GPa). The elongation in the Fe-Fe pairs was suppressed with increasing pressure, and the distances of the three pairs were comparable under pressures above the magnetic transition from ferromagnetic to paramagnetic phase at Pc≈7 GPa. Therefore, the Fe-Fe pairs dominantly contribute to the volume expansion due to the magnetovolume effect. Because a similar magnitude of elongation was observed in the Fe-Fe pairs of a non-Invar Fe-Ni alloy, we conclude that the Invar effect originates from the delicate balance between the number of Fe-Fe pairs and their elongation depending on the magnetization.
data.zhAbstract: 在本研究中，利用扩展X射线吸收精细结构和X射线衍射的互补数据集，通过反向蒙特卡罗分析研究了因瓦合金Fe65Ni35中观察到的近零热膨胀——因瓦效应的原子尺度起源。在本研究的最小压力（0.6 GPa）下，最近邻Fe-Fe原子对的原子间距离比Fe-Ni和Ni-Ni对的原子间距离长约0.02 Å。随着压力增加，Fe-Fe对中的伸长受到抑制，在压力高于从铁磁相到顺磁相的磁转变压力（Pc≈7 GPa）时，这三对原子的距离相当。因此，由于磁体积效应，Fe-Fe对主要导致体积膨胀。因为在非因瓦Fe-Ni合金的Fe-Fe对中观察到了类似程度的伸长，我们得出结论，因瓦效应源于Fe-Fe对的数量与其取决于磁化强度的伸长之间的微妙平衡。

data.enName: Thermal Expansion Properties of Fe-Ni-Co Super-Invar Alloy with Mn
data.zhName: Mn元素对Fe-Ni-Co合金热膨胀性能影响
data.enAbstract: Investigation was made on the effect of Mn on both phase and thermal expansion properties of(Fe64Ni32Co4)1-xMnx(x=0,2.2,4.4,6.6(%,mass fraction)) alloy.The hyperfine magnetic field distribution(HMFD) of alloys was measured by Mossbauer spectra to study the influenced mechanism of Mn on the thermal expansion property.The results revealed that Mn added alloy has single FCC phase,and the thermal expansion coefficient of alloys increased with increasing the Mn content.The mossbauer spectra of the alloys with low content Mn(x≤4.4%) were composed of ferromagnetic pattern,but it was composed of ferromagnetic and paramagnetic patterns when the Mn content was increased to 6.6%.The main reason for the increase of thermal expansion coefficient of(Fe64Ni32Co4)1-xMnx alloys is that the volume contraction effect in the process of high spin Fe atoms transfer to low spin Fe atoms with increasing temperature is weaken by the decrease of high spin Fe atoms with increasing the Mn content.
data.zhAbstract: 研究了Mn对(Fe64Ni32Co4)1-xMnx(x=0,2.2,4.4,6.6(%,质量分数))合金物相、热膨胀性能影响,利用穆斯堡尔谱分析了合金内场分布及Mn对合金热膨胀性能的影响机制。结果表明,Mn促使合金生成FCC单相,增大其热膨胀系数。Mn含量较低时,穆斯堡尔谱为连续的铁磁六线谱迭加而成,当Mn含量增加到6.6%后则由顺磁单峰和铁磁六线谱迭加组成,Mn元素添加降低了合金中高自旋Fe原子数量,进而减弱升温过程中高自旋Fe原子向低自旋原子引起的体积缩小作用,是导致合金热膨胀系数增加的主要原因。

data.pieces: Thermal Expansion Properties of Fe-Ni-Co Super-Invar Alloy with Mn. Investigation was made on the effect of Mn on both phase and thermal expansion properties of(Fe64Ni32Co4)1-xMnx(x=0,2.2,4.4,6.6(%,mass fraction)) alloy.The hyperfine magnetic field distribution(HMFD) of alloys was measured by Mossbauer spectra to study the influenced mechanism of Mn on the thermal expansion property.The results revealed that Mn added alloy has single FCC phase,and the thermal expansion coefficient of alloys increased with increasing the Mn content.The mossbauer spectra of the alloys with low content Mn(x≤4.4%) were composed of ferromagnetic pattern,but it was composed of ferromagnetic and paramagnetic patterns when the Mn content was increased to 6.6%.The main reason for the increase of thermal expansion coefficient of(Fe64Ni32Co4)1-xMnx alloys is that the volume contraction effect in the process of high spin Fe atoms transfer to low spin Fe atoms with increasing temperature is weaken by the decrease of high spin Fe atoms with increasing the Mn content.

data.enName: Lattice Defects of Cold-drawn and Aged Fe-36wt%Ni Alloys and Effects of Additions of C and V on Hardness and Thermal Expansion
data.zhName: 冷拉和时效 Fe-36wt%Ni 合金的晶格缺陷以及添加 C 和 V 对硬度和热膨胀的影响
data.enAbstract: Fe-36wt%Ni invar alloy has been widely used for precision parts where dimensional changes with temperature are unfavorable. In the viewpoint of industrial application, high-strength with low-thermal-expansion alloys are in increased demand for structural members such as power cables and electronic devices. Additions of alloying elements to and cold working on Fe-Ni alloys are effective methods that enable the alloys to strengthen, although these modifications also influence the magnitude of thermal expansion. In this study, effects of additions of 0.2wt%C and/or 0.8wt%V on hardness and thermal expansion of cold-drawn and aged Fe-36wt%Ni invar alloys are reported. Hardness in solution-treated and as-drawn conditions increased with addition of C, and, when both C and V were added, hardness of the alloy reached its maximum after aged at 650°C. Besides an increase in hardness with addition of any of C and V, thermal expansion below Tc became smaller in as-drawn condition than in solution-treated condition. Measurements of positron lifetimes revealed that vacancies introduced by cold-drawing were annealed out through aging up to 300°C and dislocation motion was activated at 500°C. Both vacancies and dislocations, especially C-dislocation complexes, seemingly influence the decrease in thermal expansion. While graphite precipitation in the C-added invar alloy showed no hardening, addition of C and V to invar alloy resulted in secondary hardening by vanadium carbide precipitation when aged over 500°C, which realized high-hardness and low-thermal-expansion.
data.zhAbstract: 铁-36wt%镍因瓦合金已广泛应用于温度变化会导致尺寸不利变化的精密零件。从工业应用的角度来看，对用于电力电缆和电子设备等结构部件的高强度低热膨胀合金的需求日益增加。向铁镍合金中添加合金元素以及进行冷加工是使合金强化的有效方法，尽管这些改性也会影响热膨胀的幅度。在本研究中，报道了添加0.2wt%C和/或0.8wt%V对冷拉和时效处理的铁-36wt%镍因瓦合金硬度和热膨胀的影响。在固溶处理和冷拉状态下，硬度随碳的添加而增加，并且当同时添加碳和钒时，合金在650°C时效后硬度达到最大值。除了添加碳和钒中的任何一种都会使硬度增加外，在冷拉状态下，低于居里温度（Tc）的热膨胀比固溶处理状态下更小。正电子寿命测量表明，冷拉引入的空位在高达300°C的时效过程中退火消失，位错运动在500°C时被激活。空位和位错，特别是碳-位错复合体，似乎都对热膨胀的降低有影响。虽然添加碳的因瓦合金中石墨析出没有产生硬化，但在因瓦合金中添加碳和钒在500°C以上时效时会因碳化钒析出而导致二次硬化，从而实现了高硬度和低热膨胀。

data.enName: Structure and thermal expansion of coordination shells in solid and liquid Invar alloys by molecular dynamics study
data.zhName: 通过分子动力学研究固态和液态因瓦合金中配位壳层的结构与热膨胀
data.enAbstract: Classical molecular dynamics simulations have been performed to study the atomic structures and thermal expansion of coordination shells in solid and liquid Invar alloys. Analysis of atomic structures reveals that there is an attraction between Fe-Ni nearest pairs, and that structural order still exists in the liquid Invar alloy. Fe—Ni bonds are found to have the smallest thermal expansion in the solid Invar alloy among three types of bonds, which plays an important role in the Invar effect. We also discover that the thermal expansion coefficient will gradually get close to the macroscopic level as the coordination shell number increases in Invar alloys. It is until the 5th coordination shell in the solid state and the 4th coordination shell in the liquid state that the thermal expansions of the coordination shells can reach the macroscale value. This study further promotes the understanding of the thermal expansions from the atomic scale.
data.zhAbstract: 已进行经典分子动力学模拟，以研究固态和液态因瓦合金中配位壳层的原子结构和热膨胀。对原子结构的分析表明，铁 - 镍最近邻对之间存在吸引力，并且液态因瓦合金中仍存在结构有序性。在固态因瓦合金中，发现铁 - 镍键在三种类型的键中热膨胀最小，这在因瓦效应中起重要作用。我们还发现，在因瓦合金中，随着配位壳层数的增加，热膨胀系数将逐渐接近宏观水平。直到固态的第5配位壳层和液态的第4配位壳层，配位壳层的热膨胀才能达到宏观尺度值。这项研究进一步促进了从原子尺度对热膨胀的理解。

data.enName: Combinatorial Development of Multicomponent Invar Alloys Via Rapid Alloy Prototyping
data.zhName: 通过快速合金原型法进行多组分因瓦合金的组合开发
data.enAbstract: To develop novel Invar alloys in the practically infinite compositional space of multicomponent alloys, rapid alloy prototyping is used to investigate five multicomponent Invar alloys with 5 at.% addition of Al, Cr, Cu, Mn and Si to a super Invar alloy (Fe 63 Ni 32 Co 5 ; at.%), respectively. All alloys show abnormally low thermal expansion coefficients below the Curie temperature and saturation magnetization deviating from the Slater-Pauling curve, revealing their Invar-behavior. The relationships among valence electron concentration, magnetic properties, and Invar behavior of the various multicomponent alloys are discussed. The Invar alloy with Cu addition is particularly promising, as it shows a 40 K larger temperature range (above room temperature) of low thermal expansion coefficient (<5.87×10 -6 K) and 2.8% higher hardness compared to the conventional super Invar alloy. The work thus also successfully demonstrates the capability of using rapid alloy prototyping for developing multicomponent multi-functional alloys.
data.zhAbstract: 为了在多组分合金几乎无限的成分空间中开发新型因瓦合金，采用快速合金原型制作方法，分别向一种超级因瓦合金（Fe 63 Ni 32 Co 5；原子百分比）中添加5原子百分比的Al、Cr、Cu、Mn和Si，研究了五种多组分因瓦合金。所有合金在居里温度以下均表现出异常低的热膨胀系数，且饱和磁化强度偏离斯莱特-鲍林曲线，显示出它们的因瓦行为。讨论了各种多组分合金的价电子浓度、磁性能和因瓦行为之间的关系。添加Cu的因瓦合金特别有前景，因为与传统超级因瓦合金相比，它在室温以上具有低至40 K的更大热膨胀系数范围（<5.87×10 -6 K），且硬度高2.8%。因此，这项工作也成功证明了使用快速合金原型制作方法开发多组分多功能合金的能力。

data.enName: Effect of deformation nanostructuring on thermal expansion and phase composition of Fe - 36% Ni alloy
data.zhName: 变形纳米结构化对Fe-36%Ni合金热膨胀及相组成的影响
data.enAbstract: The influence of deformation nanostructuring and subsequent annealing on the temperature dependence of the thermal expansion coefficient of the Fe-36% Ni Invar alloy is studied. The nanostructured state was obtained by severe plastic deformation via high pressure torsion in Bridgman anvils. An "anomalous" contraction of the nanostructured Fe-36% Ni alloy was detected during heating in certain temperature ranges. The phase composition of the nanostructured Invar was studied to explain the behavior of the thermal expansion coefficient. The revealed anomalies of the coefficients are explained by the formation of a bcc phase not observed in the Fe-36% Ni Invar alloy in the coarse-grained state. The formation of this phase becomes possible due to a significant increase in the diffusion coefficient as a result of nanostructuring.
data.zhAbstract: 研究了变形纳米结构化及随后的退火对Fe-36%Ni因瓦合金热膨胀系数温度依赖性的影响。通过在布里奇曼砧座中进行高压扭转的严重塑性变形获得纳米结构状态。在特定温度范围内加热时，检测到纳米结构的Fe-36%Ni合金出现“异常”收缩。研究了纳米结构因瓦合金的相组成，以解释热膨胀系数的行为。系数的异常现象是由于在粗晶状态的Fe-36%Ni因瓦合金中未观察到的体心立方相的形成所致。由于纳米结构化导致扩散系数显著增加，使得该相的形成成为可能。
